It can be accessed from the {{Zone|Moonglade Marsh}} after unlocking {{Coll|Heart of the Forest 4}}. == Features == ===Chapters=== The '''Torrhus Canyon''' has a total of {{Yellow|63}} tasks across 7 chapters. These chapters can be accessed by speaking to {{NPCSprite|Helia}}. {{:Chapters/Torrhus Canyon}} ===Foraging Mechanics=== Helix Trees can be chopped to get {{Item|Helix Log}}s. Helix Trees have {{Stat|Toughness|150}} and a cutting style of {{Green|Beige Logs}} → {{Green|Red Logs}}. {{Item|Honeycomb}} can be collected from [[Honeyhive]]s found around the Island. {{Item|Ruby Veilshroom}} can be found inside caves in the {{Zone|Torrhus Springs}} or dropped by [[Sea Creatures]] fished on the {{Zone|Torrhus Canyon}}. ===Critters=== {{:Critters/Torrhus Canyon}} ===Sea Creatures=== {{:Sea Creatures/List/Torrhus Canyon}} == Zones == {{:Locations/Torrhus Canyon}} == NPCs == {{Location NPCs}} == Fairy Souls == {{Fairy Souls}} == Trivia == * The release of the '''Torrhus Canyon''' marks the first time since [[SkyBlock]]'s release where more than one island has been released in one update. * Despite [[Miria]] implying in her dialogue that you have completed [[Starlyn Contests]] in the [[Moonglade Marsh]], you can reach the '''Torrhus Canyon''' without completing any.
